pick.headline: US warplanes bomb Tripoli and Benghazi
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of April 15, 1986, led with the U.S. raids: Tripoli radio claimed over 20 U.S. planes downed and vowed to kill captured pilots, while reports differed on whether Qadhdhafi was hurt and on 'dozens' or 'hundreds' of casualties.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 072, 15 April 1986
evidence.snippet: FBIS DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST & SOUTH ASIA REVIEW 15 APRIL 1986 U.S. Raids on Libya Libyan air defense sources cited by Tripoli radio claimed that over 20 U.S. planes were downed in the “failed barbaric” attack on targets in Libya 15 April. alternates.headline: Former Chinese party leader Hu Yaobang dies
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 17, 1989, carried Moscow TASS in English citing XINHUA's obituary: Hu Yaobang, 'a prominent party official and statesman', had died that morning of a heart attack, with a brief career sketch.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 072, 17 April 1989
